dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, Fah is here at the mall, but I can't see her.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈfɑː ɪz ˈhɪr ət ðə ˈmɔːl, bʌt aɪ ˈkænt ˈsiː hɜːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She's wearing jeans and a yellow sweater.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ˈwɛrɪŋ ˈdʒiːnz ənd ə ˈjɛloʊ ˈswɛtər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! It's freezing in the mall. Fah always wears warm clothes here.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ɪts ˈfriːzɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈmɔːl. ˈfɑː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈwɛrz ˈwɔːrm ˈkloʊðz ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is that her? The girl in the black jacket?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðæt ˈhɜːr? ðə ˈɡɜːrl ɪn ðə ˈblæk ˈdʒækɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, that girl is wearing a skirt. Fah is wearing jeans today.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðæt ˈɡɜːrl ɪz ˈwɛrɪŋ ə ˈskɜːrt. ˈfɑː ɪz ˈwɛrɪŋ ˈdʒiːnz təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, look! A girl in a yellow sweater is coming this way.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈlʊk! ə ˈɡɜːrl ɪn ə ˈjɛloʊ ˈswɛtər ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈðɪs ˈweɪ.
